name: trelliswm
title: TrellisWM
description: Control the TrellisWM window manager: zoom, move between spaces, and open named saved views
author: sean_lea

commands.name: saved-views
commands.title: Saved Views
commands.description: Name, open and save your nine TrellisWM views

commands.name: save-view
commands.title: Save View
commands.description: Choose a view, then save where you are looking into it. Asks before it replaces a view

commands.name: go-to-view
commands.title: Go to View
commands.description: Choose a saved view by name and go to it

commands.name: show-everything
commands.title: Show Everything
commands.description: Zoom out to show every window you have open

commands.name: zoom-in
commands.title: Zoom in
commands.description: Step in one level, toward the window you are using

commands.name: go-back
commands.title: Go Back
commands.description: Go back to the previous place

commands.name: go-forward
commands.title: Go Forward
commands.description: Go forward to the next place

commands.name: space-left
commands.title: Go to Space on Left
commands.description: Move to the neighbouring space on the left

commands.name: space-right
commands.title: Go to Space on Right
commands.description: Move to the neighbouring space on the right

commands.name: space-up
commands.title: Go to Space Above
commands.description: Move to the neighbouring space above

commands.name: space-down
commands.title: Go to Space Below
commands.description: Move to the neighbouring space below

commands.name: frame-window
commands.title: Frame Window
commands.description: Show the focused window on its own. Run again to go back

commands.name: frame-desktop
commands.title: Frame Desktop
commands.description: Show the Desktop on its own

commands.name: split-with-finder
commands.title: Split with Finder
commands.description: Split the current window with a new Finder window

commands.name: float-all-windows
commands.title: Float All Windows
commands.description: Float all your windows on the Desktop

commands.name: open-settings
commands.title: Open Settings
commands.description: Open TrellisWM settings at a pane
